tasks.description: In FilterContext.tsx, replace the single line `const debouncedSearch = useDebounce(search, 0);` (line 51) with two lines: `const rawDebouncedSearch = useDebounce(search, search === '' ? 0 : 300);` and `const debouncedSearch = search === '' ? '' : rawDebouncedSearch;`. The first line passes a conditional delay so useDebounce's effect cleanup cancels any pending 300ms timer when search clears. The second line overrides the hook's output synchronously to '' when search is empty, making clearing instantaneous on the same render without waiting for any setTimeout — satisfying the synchronous assertions in clearFilters.test.tsx and debounceSearch.test.tsx.
